agents.goal: Assess the candidate's legal knowledge and communication skills
agents.name: Interviewer

constraints: Answer questions without prior knowledge of the interviewer's questions
agents.goal: Demonstrate legal expertise and suitability for the position
agents.name: Candidate

agents.goal: Accurately record the interview for later review
agents.name: Note-Taker

causes.hypothesis: Higher legal knowledge leads to better interview performance
causes.name: Legal knowledge

causes.hypothesis: Clearer communication improves the perceived competence of the candidate
causes.name: Communication clarity

causes.hypothesis: Higher confidence correlates with better interview outcomes
causes.name: Confidence level

interaction.stopping_rule: After the candidate answers all questions and the note-taker records the session

outcome.measurement_question: How competent is the candidate based on their responses?
outcome.name: Interview success
outcome.operationalization: The interviewer's assessment of the candidate's competence

scenario: A person is interviewing for a job as a lawyer
